name: Demo studio
description: Turns a brief into a script and a storyboard for a narrated product demo video, with Claude writing the script through the demo_* tools.

settings.label: ElevenLabs API key
settings.description: For the Final narration (demo_render with voice "final"). Kept in this extension's own secrets, never in the vault.

settings.label: Swedish voice (Edge)
settings.description: The draft voice for Swedish narration.

settings.label: English voice (Edge)
settings.description: The draft voice for English narration.

settings.label: ElevenLabs voice id
settings.description: The voice of the Final narration. Ask the session for voice samples (demo_voice_samples) to pick one by ear.

settings.label: ElevenLabs model
settings.description: The model of the Final narration.

settings.label: ffmpeg path
settings.description: Full path to ffmpeg on the machine prifly runs on, with ffprobe beside it. Empty: found on PATH, or where winget installs it on Windows.

settings.label: ODI checkout
settings.description: The ODI checkout the dry run builds the mockup harness from (its HEAD commit, in a throwaway worktree). On Windows a path inside WSL.

settings.label: prifly checkout
settings.description: The prifly checkout the dry run builds the desktop-web preview harness from. On Windows a path inside WSL.

settings.label: WSL distribution
settings.description: On Windows, the WSL distribution that holds the checkouts; empty for the default one.

settings.label: My voice: Seed-VC variant
settings.description: For demo_render with voice "mine" (local conversion on an NVIDIA GPU). B: the 44.1 kHz model, matched to your pitch (default). A: the 22 kHz speech model, no pitch matching. Changing it converts the scenes again.

settings.label: Your voice reference folder
settings.description: Your voice: a folder of your own clean recordings to build the voice reference from. Empty uses your dictation recordings when the box below is on.

settings.label: Use my dictation recordings
settings.description: Your voice: lets demo_voice_reference pick clear pieces from the recordings prifly keeps when Settings > Dictation > Keep recordings is on.
